title: Mebendazole Mediates Proteasomal Degradation of GLI Transcription Factors in Acute Myeloid Leukemia.
authors: Freisleben, Fabian; Modemann, Franziska; Muschhammer, Jana; Stamm, Hauke; Brauneck, Franziska; Krispien, Alexander; Bokemeyer, Carsten; Kirschner, Karl N; Wellbrock, Jasmin; Fiedler, Walter
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甲苯咪唑通过HSP90抑制促进GLI转录因子降解的抗白血病机制，虽涉及转录因子和分子动力学模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The prognosis of elderly AML patients is still poor due to chemotherapy resistance. The Hedgehog (HH) pathway is important for leukemic transformation because of aberrant activation of GLI transcription factors. MBZ is a well-tolerated anthelmintic that exhibits strong antitumor effects. Herein, we show that MBZ induced strong, dose-dependent anti-leukemic effects on AML cells, including the sensitization of AML cells to chemotherapy with cytarabine. MBZ strongly reduced intracellular protein levels of GLI1/GLI2 transcription factors. Consequently, MBZ reduced the GLI promoter activity as observed in luciferase-based reporter assays in AML cell lines. Further analysis revealed that MBZ mediates its anti-leukemic effects by promoting the proteasomal degradation of GLI transcription factors via inhibition of HSP70/90 chaperone activity. Extensive molecular dynamics simulations were performed on the MBZ-HSP90 complex, showing a stable binding interaction at the ATP binding site. Importantly, two patients with refractory AML were treated with MBZ in an off-label setting and MBZ effectively reduced the GLI signaling activity in a modified plasma inhibitory assay, resulting in a decrease in peripheral blood blast counts in one patient. Our data prove that MBZ is an effective GLI inhibitor that should be evaluated in combination to conventional chemotherapy in the clinical setting.
abstract_zh: 老年急性髓系白血病（AML）患者的预后因化疗耐药性而仍然较差。Hedgehog（HH）通路因GLI转录因子的异常激活，在白血病转化中起重要作用。MBZ是一种耐受性良好的抗蠕虫药，表现出强效抗肿瘤作用。在此，我们显示MBZ对AML细胞诱导了强效、剂量依赖性的抗白血病效应，包括使AML细胞对阿糖胞苷化疗增敏。MBZ显著降低了GLI1/GLI2转录因子的细胞内蛋白水平。相应地，在基于荧光素酶的报告基因实验中，MBZ降低了AML细胞系中的GLI启动子活性。进一步分析揭示，MBZ通过抑制HSP70/90伴侣活性，促进GLI转录因子的蛋白酶体降解，从而介导其抗白血病效应。对MBZ-HSP90复合物进行了广泛的分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟，显示其在ATP结合位点具有稳定的结合相互作用。重要的是，两名难治性AML患者在标签外使用MBZ治疗，在改良血浆抑制实验中，MBZ有效降低了GLI信号活性，导致其中一名患者外周血原始细胞计数下降。我们的数据证明，MBZ是一种有效的GLI抑制剂，应在临床环境中与常规化疗联合评估。
